title: The Same River, Twice
summary: First Anonymoses show and music by free improv ensemble
notes:
This event was organised by me with Anonymoses. It was our first gig and a send-off for our dear friend Vice before he returned home to Chile. We were formed after a free improv session and are inspired by King Crimson and some other things. At this gig, we performed an hour-long set of original music. 

Anonymoses:
James Wolfe - guitar, vocals
Vicente Reyes - synth, violin
Thomas Kerr - bass
Josh Dorrell - drums 

The Holy Child of Father Sun was a once-off free improv group led by Vicente:

Vicente Reyes - synth, violin
Phelim O'Laoghaire - laptop
Cillian Bent - drum kit
Thomas Kerr - drum kit
James Wolfe - guitar

James (Enola Christ Metalizer) also joined in on a bin.

Jack Leitch created video design for both sets. Phelim also performed a brilliant set as Greet.
